correct_alts:
The publish-docs job stopped in publish.sh because DEPLOY_TOKEN was empty.
The run came from a fork, and forks do not get repository secrets, so the script refused to go on, which is expected behavior for an untrusted trigger.

No credential reached the publishing script: DEPLOY_TOKEN is unset in the job environment because fork-triggered workflows are given no secrets, and publish-docs then exited with code 64 and the deploy never started.
